glosses: because of her, for her sake
because of them, for their sake
as far as she is concerned (she doesn't mind if); for all she cares

examples.text: Ich bin ihretwegen noch immer sauer.
examples.en: I'm still angry because of her.

examples.text: Ihretwegen bin ich aus der Gruppe ausgetreten.
examples.en: It's because of you that I quit the team.
